annotations.title: Configure Email OTP, Webhook Receipt & Push Module Switches

description: Configure per-app module switches (ON/OFF) for Transactional Email OTP, Automated Payment Webhook Email Receipts, Order Status Emails, and the Web Push Notification collector, plus sender brand name and Reply-To email address. Use this tool to enable or disable individual channels per website; do not use it to send an immediate email or OTP (use send_transactional_email instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, app_id, push_enabled, email_otp_enabled, email_invoice_enabled, email_status_enabled, email_brand_name, email_reply_to }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

email_brand_name.description: Sender brand name shown in the recipient inbox (e.g., 'Kopi Nusantara')

email_invoice_enabled.description: Set true to automatically send paid invoice receipts via email when a payment webhook arrives

email_otp_enabled.description: Set true to enable 6-digit Email OTP generation and verification for this app

email_reply_to.description: Business Reply-To email address where customer replies are routed

email_status_enabled.description: Set true to enable order status and shipping tracking emails

push_enabled.description: Set true to enable Web Push Notification collection on the website, or false to disable

name: configure_email_automation
